title: _drop_visible fails-open for unknown privacy values
description: In python/src/lichen/coap/resources/deaddrop.py lines 402-414, the _drop_visible method checks 'if privacy not in _PRIVACY_RESTRICTED' and returns True (visible). This means unknown privacy values are treated as public, violating the spec 18.9 requirement that unknown privacy MUST NOT fail-open. While entry points validate privacy values, this is a defense-in-depth violation. The fix should explicitly check for 'public' or fail closed for unknown values.
